technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present recovery potential, but severe downtrend structure (death cross, below all major MAs, negative CMF, bearish MACD) and lack of bullish confirmation make this a high-risk bounce trade rather than a swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CNP shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 48 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (2+ years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5), flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and utilities sector credit stress create severely adverse macro conditions; earnings in 48 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (11/100) and proximity to support (24.3977) create a classic contrarian bounce setup with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe structural downtrend (death cross, price below all major MAs, negative CMF/MACD, no bullish confirmation), crisis-level VIX (383.5), FOMC event today, earnings in 48 hours, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a trap bounce with unfavourable macro backdrop.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) at support offer contrarian bounce potential. However, severe structural downtrend (death cross, price below all MAs, negative CMF/MACD) with zero bullish confirmation and crisis macro backdrop (VIX 383.5, FOMC today) make risk/reward unfavourable.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event today combined with earnings in 48 days creates binary event risk; macro crisis conditions and lack of institutional support increase probability of failed bounce into further downside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk; debate winner (bear, score 9) reflects consensus that macro/structural headwinds outweigh oversold technicals
decision.portfolio_note: Already 9 positions in Utilities sector; adding CNP increases concentration risk in low-conviction, high-risk environment with unfavourable macro setup.
